evidence_policy: User attachments and tool checks remain local; this file contains a privacy-filtered synthesis, not original captures or a new run.

observations.observation: macOS rejected Internet Sharing because the source connection was protected by 802.1X
observations.scope: this source-sharing attempt only; campus-wide isolation not established

observations.observation: Local wired IPv6 SSH, then static IPv4 SSH, worked during the session
observations.scope: earlier management stages, not final wired topology acceptance

observations.observation: Temporary board wired IPv4 disappeared; ping selected Wi-Fi source; camera neighbor remained reachable
observations.interpretation: NetworkManager reactivation may have cleared the temporary address; causal service logs not captured

observations.observation: school-camera static profile activated; direct wired route and TCP ports 80, 554, 8899 connected
observations.scope: TCP reachability, not a new school ONVIF operation

observations.observation: Computer-hotspot FFplay process/probe existed; later explicit video-stream three-second decode passed; user reported black or frozen window
observations.scope: visual preview not accepted; an earlier two-second decode check returned nonzero

observations.scope: no measured latency or comparative throughput

observations.observation: Intermittent SSH timeouts; later ping and SSH banners succeeded; compatibility options and retries were added
observations.scope: QoS and proxy not proven to be root cause; EF, CS0 and system-default banner tests all succeeded when checked
